description.narrative: Reform of the pension indexation led by the Ministry of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (MOLISA), consulted nationwide with stakeholders in July 2020 with a clear roadmap for reforms for promoting pension adequacy and sustainability of the pension system. - ILO provided technical notes on principles and international practice for adjusting pensions. - A review of capacities and resources undertaken and recommendations provided to the Viet Nam Social Security (VSS). - Training on client satisfaction survey tools for VSS; coaching for rolling out national satisfaction survey; and capacity building on customer care skills for VSS Customer Care Centre. - Capacity building of Viet Nam General Confederation of Labour (VGCL) staff on health insurance and health-related social security benefits; Mass Awareness raising events to increase female factory workers awareness on their social health protection benefits organized; comprehensive and user friendly booklet on health related social security benefits and procedures prepared.
